Agendas and Minutes

	
                    


    



Agendas and minutes for Council meetings and committees
Council, Committee, Council Assessment Panel (CAP) meetings, and Councillor Information and Workshop Sessions are open to the public and media except on occasions where there is discussion of confidential items. Meetings are held on Level 1 of Payinthi situated at 128 Prospect Road, Prospect.
Members of the public are able to view Council Meetings only via the live stream on Council’s YouTube channel here: https://www.youtube.com/user/CityofProspect1
The agendas and minutes of Council meetings and committee are in PDF format.
View the Council Meeting and Information and Workshop schedule here.

Agendas and Minutes

	
                    


    



Agendas and minutes for Council meetings and committees
Council, Committee, Council Assessment Panel (CAP) meetings, and Councillor Information and Workshop Sessions are open to the public and media except on occasions where there is discussion of confidential items. Meetings are held on Level 1 of Payinthi situated at 128 Prospect Road, Prospect.
Members of the public are able to view Council Meetings only via the live stream on Council’s YouTube channel here: https://www.youtube.com/user/CityofProspect1
The agendas and minutes of Council meetings and committee are in PDF format.

Agendas and Minutes

	
                    


    



Agendas and minutes for Council meetings and committees
Council, Committee, Council Assessment Panel (CAP) meetings, and Councillor Information and Workshop Sessions are open to the public and media except on occasions where there is discussion of confidential items. Meetings are held on Level 1 of Payinthi situated at 128 Prospect Road, Prospect.
Members of the public are able to view Council Meetings only via the live stream on Council’s YouTube channel here: https://www.youtube.com/user/CityofProspect1
The agendas and minutes of Council meetings and committee are in PDF format.
View the Council Meeting and Information and Workshop schedule here.
